appDescription: A driving cost assistant that finds the cheapest fuel station, charger or route and tracks the money the user has actually saved.

function.name: FIND_CHEAPEST_STATION
function.description: Find the fuel station or EV charger with the lowest total cost, including the detour, near the current route.

stationType.description: Whether to look for a fuel station or an EV charger.

function.name: COMPARE_ROUTE_COST
function.description: Compare the total cost of tolls and energy for the available routes to a destination and recommend the cheapest one.

destination.description: Name or address of the destination.

function.name: GET_SAVINGS_SUMMARY
function.description: Report how much money the user has saved and the current character level.
